vb_textbox.text: I picked one of the gnomes and clicked on it for the first two rounds, then clicked on the other for a further two rounds.Whichever gnome was the best from those initial 4 rounds i continued to click on that one for each further round until the score dropped. Then I would choose the other gnome to see if their score was better (I gave them two chances). I continued like this trying to maximise my score.
